places.name: Rub' al Khali Desert
places.connection: The Rub' al Khali Desert, also known as the Empty Quarter, is a significant location depicted in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception, where much of the game's action takes place.

places.name: Château de la Roche-Guyon
places.connection: The Château de la Roche-Guyon is the inspiration for the French chateau level in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception.

places.name: Columbia University
places.connection: Columbia University is depicted in the game as a location where Nathan Drake meets with a character to discuss Sir Francis Drake's ring.

places.name: Petra
places.connection: Petra is referenced in the game as part of the historical and archaeological background related to the lost city of Ubar.

places.name: Naughty Dog Studio
places.connection: Naughty Dog Studio in Santa Monica is where Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception was developed.
